en/kb-detail: AWS denied access to this resource — this deployment's role lacks permission, or the id belongs to another account.
en/registry-edit: Failed to load record: AWS rejected the request as invalid — check the id or the values you entered.
en/memory-short-term: Memory lookup failed: The AWS resource was not found — it may have been deleted, or the id is wrong.
zh-CN/kb-detail: AWS 拒绝访问该资源——本部署的角色缺少权限,或该 id 属于其他账号。
zh-CN/registry-edit: 加载记录失败：AWS 拒绝了该请求(参数无效)——请检查 id 或输入的值。
zh-CN/memory-short-term: 读取记忆失败：未找到该 AWS 资源——可能已被删除,或 id 有误。
